company_name: Southern Taiwan Science Park Bureau, National Science and Technology Council
semiconductor_relevance: High — the Southern Taiwan Science Park Bureau plays a critical role in fostering the semiconductor industry through the development of science parks that support various semiconductor-related sectors.
summary: The Southern Taiwan Science Park Bureau oversees the development and management of multiple science parks in southern Taiwan, focusing on attracting advanced technology industries, including integrated circuits and optoelectronics. It aims to enhance innovation and collaboration within the semiconductor ecosystem, promoting sustainable industrial development.
capabilities: Promotion of industrial innovation and sustainability

regional_presence.Taiwan: The Bureau manages several science parks in southern Taiwan, including Tainan and Kaohsiung, which are integral to the region's semiconductor industry.
